shared_elements: paired symmetrical elements flanking a central axis
low-relief carving covering a whole field
repeated small incised signs/motifs in registers
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief human-related imagery organised around a central axis with a prominent circular disc and symmetric flanking motifs, but these are generic correspondences any tradition could reach independently. A depicts a narrative scene of small standing figures in profile adoring a rayed disc above an offering table, with dense registers of script beneath, whereas B is a single frontal anthropomorphic figure whose body itself is the field, bearing abstract rings, paired knobs and curved bands rather than a scene or text.
